working: Use ΔG° = -nFE°, since E° values themselves are not additive but ΔG° values are. For Fe3+ + 3e- → Fe: ΔG° = -3F(-0.04) = +0.12F. For Fe2+ + 2e- → Fe: ΔG° = -2F(-0.44) = +0.88F. Subtracting the second from the first gives Fe3+ + e- → Fe2+, with ΔG° = 0.12F - 0.88F = -0.76F. With n = 1, E° = -ΔG°/F = +0.76 V.
